comments.content: ROUND 4 RETURNED — THE STOP HOLDS, 2/2. The regression sweep found no drift and the suite still falsifies what it claims (equality pin, exact-20 corpus, unit pins all re-confirmed). PHASE-3 STOP DECIDED: four rounds (discovery, two full verifies, one narrowed stop-decider), 26 findings consolidated and fixed across three fix passes plus the forced core-removal migration, every fix claim independently verified, the last round finding only carried-tier residue. Layer 2's code rounds close; phase 4 routes the residue; the operator batch comes due at the boundary.
